top_signals.title: Important That GOP Appeals to Black Voters in GA, Says McCormick
top_signals.summary: Republican Representative from Georgia Rich McCormick said that addressing hurdles to gains made by the African American community in Georgia is more important than any one candidate running in the state and that it is important the Republican party appeal to Black voters in a state where minorities make up a majority of the voting population.  (Source: Bloomberg)
